slides.title: Dar opinião
slides.text: Em inglês, 'I think…' e 'In my opinion…' dão opinião. Para suavizar: 'I tend to think…', 'It seems to me…'. Use 'because' para justificar.
Will e Isla saem do cinema e discutem o filme.
slides.line: What do you think of the movie, Will?

slides.title: Movie night debate
slides.text: After the movie, Will and Isla go to a cafe and talk about it for an hour. Will loved the story and the acting. "I think it's the best movie of the year," he says. Isla liked the music but thought the ending was boring. "In my opinion, it was too long," she says. They disagree, but they respect each other's opinion. They look at the reviews on their phones: four stars! At the end they give the movie three and a half stars and order a second coffee.
slides.pt: Dois amigos debatem o filme e chegam a três estrelas e meia.

slides.title: Cinema e estrelas
slides.text: Os críticos de cinema dão 'stars' (estrelas): cinco é excelente e uma é péssimo. Em inglês, 'a must-see' é um filme imperdível e 'a flop' é um fracasso de bilheteria.
